truck.origin: ground at wheel contact, centred on chassis

animationNotes.drive: 2 s wheel-roll loop, in place; translate fire_truck along +Z at 3.14 m/s
animationNotes.ladder_extend: 4 s; raise base, then telescope overlapping nested truss stages
animationNotes.ladder_retract: 4 s inverse deployment; play once, clamp last frame
animationNotes.lights: 1 s alternating emissive chip visibility loop; opaque housings remain

truck.provenance: Original mesh and materials; existing repository truck assets inspected as references only; no copied geometry, textures or third-party marks.

building.assembly: Place shell at origin. Place building-floor-N at [0, (N-1)*3.2, 0].

cutaway.note: Full front walls and ceilings are included; hide only for cutaway inspection.

stateContract.burning: intact visible; fire anchor drives runtime flame and accumulating smoke sprites
stateContract.burntNotes: intact scale zero; burnt scale one. Geometry collapses with char and ash faces.

smoke.accumulation: Fill ceiling first; extend to mid then low over exposure time. Ventilation may decay density.

source.scope: CC0 furniture geometry and geometry helper adapted; new shell stairs damage state composition.

states.intact: intact visible; burnt hidden; fire FX disabled
states.burning: intact visible; burnt hidden; fire FX at fire_<id>; smoke fills ceiling
states.burnt: intact hidden; burnt visible; fire FX disabled; smoke may linger

runtimeNotes: No model fallback or second truck. Load fire-truck.glb before showing it.
GLBs embed all data and use no required extensions or decoder.
Run named clips via the host animation mixer; one-shot clips clamp at the endpoint.
Building-floor-N is local to floor; position at y=(N-1)*3.2.
Hide cutaway_front_* and cutaway_ceiling_* only in inspection view. Keep for a closed gameplay interior.
Smoke/particles and animation orchestration live in preview.mjs and runtime.mjs; GLB contains stable anchors, not a game simulation.
